parsed.why: No trans-specific criminalisation; broad gender-identity non-discrimination law and no documented trans abuses. Border/facility practice untested, so slightly below safest tier.
Criminalisation of gender expression repealed only recently, but dress-code policing, morality-law arrests, imprisonment risk and official hostility persist; state-directed severe exposure.
No trans-specific criminal law, but documented torture/extortion pattern, weak hate-crime recourse, public acceptance 5/100 and hostile officials create severe societal/state-tolerated risk.
Decriminalised; 2024 gender-identity hate-crime enhancement; no documented trans targeting. Enforcement and border/facility practice unknown, keeping it reduced risk, not low.
No criminalisation; hate-speech/conversion laws and protection in one part, but no gender-identity discrimination regime, inconsistent police action and divided enforcement keep it elevated.
